```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 04_variability_average_deviations
title: >
  Why can't we simply average the raw deviations from the mean?
questions:
  - id: average_deviations
    type: free-response
    checkLabel: Compare your answer
    answer: >
      The mean is the balance point of the distribution, so the negative deviations
      below it and the positive deviations above it balance each other out. The
      signed deviations therefore always add up to zero. Their average would be zero
      too, no matter how much the scores varied.
```
